review.decision: Implement the registered snapshot preview and verify it on isolated fixtures.
review.notes: Revised before test implementation. Links printed for terminal delivery carry only snapshot identity. Pairing remains a separate owner action. Use the registered parent for local HTML image resolution, allow resource-free CSS for layout, and account for all admitted raster images. Verify the bundled CLI and macOS route separately from ordinary HTTP navigation.

cases.description: Local show resolves only a canonical registered ID and validates immutable bytes
cases.setup: Private HOME and project fixture files registered through the real artifact store.
cases.action: Invoke actual show with ID and URI, then change/delete original; separately try bad IDs, removed entries and corrupt snapshot bytes.
cases.expected: Exact registered metadata and original scope are returned after byte/hash checks; source changes do not replace the snapshot. Missing/revoked/corrupt fail without source fallback or scanning.

cases.description: Registration and local open produce an identity-only terminal link
cases.setup: Private artifact store and injected local browser opener.
cases.action: Read Markdown and JSON registration outputs, open by ID and URI, and print a URL for a nondefault port. Round-trip reserved identity characters. Reject invalid flags and opener errors.
cases.expected: Both App reference and local HTTP link name the registered bytes. The link contains only the original document/session/home and the browser must pair independently.

cases.description: Startup document fragments reject ambiguous or malformed identity
cases.setup: Real standalone browser fragment parser with encoded and duplicate parameter controls.
cases.action: Parse the identity-only link, rejecting invalid, mixed credential/document, duplicate and overlong fields.
cases.expected: Only bounded canonical requests reach the reader; fragment parsing grants no access and no arbitrary filesystem route.

cases.description: Local startup previews the same authenticated conversation snapshot
cases.setup: Existing synthetic fixture, isolated headless browser, registered HTML/image metadata and delayed access/content responses.
cases.action: Open the generated identity fragment with an existing browser credential or by entering a pairing code. Check guest denial, wrong home, changed ID, byte length/digest mismatch, revocation, inline and parent-scoped local PNGs, CSS layout and resource restrictions.
cases.expected: Only verified bytes for the requested identity render. The browser admits bounded PNG/JPEG images through one image path and preserves resource-free layout. Closing or losing access retires the viewer.

cases.description: macOS file URI routing invokes the same explicit local preview command
cases.setup: Production URL dispatcher, packaged host and disposable synthetic artifact in an isolated macOS runner.
cases.action: Check canonical URL mapping and existing usage scheme, then deliver a synthetic file URL to the built host and record the target passed to its browser opener.
cases.expected: The app routes only canonical snapshot IDs through the CLI. The local browser target matches the registered identity; existing usage links stay routable.

cases.description: Verified PDF has an explicit browser preview action and malformed PDF stays unsupported
cases.setup: Private synthetic PDF metadata/content in the existing isolated browser fixture; no real file or user download.
cases.action: Open a PDF with matching hash and valid signature; inspect the explicit blob-backed user action and close the viewer. Repeat with invalid signature.
cases.expected: No automatic new window or external fetch occurs. The ready action uses only verified PDF bytes and noreferrer/noopener; malformed PDF never exposes the action. Closing cancels viewer resources.
